analysis_disclosure: Gemini E4 (0/112) and E5 (0/96) are dev-ceiling results; neither is bought as a scored judge. Harm contrasts: no harm observable at ceiling. Qwen remains the preregistered REPLICATION judge; every scored Qwen contrast is exploratory-primary (judge substitution due to ceiling). Gemini remains the attacker. Weak control is not run. Good approval is gated only in A, V, W, R and E4 F_correct; F and U are excluded by design.
dev_reuse: All 208 current Qwen initial judgments are an unchanged subset of completed Amendment 12b dev. refresh-dev verifies exact request identity/settings/messages/tools against completed ledger replies, reconstructs and compares trials, then recomputes gates locally.
